caption: The drawing depicts an ornate pitcher with a lid, featuring a blue base color accented by gold decorative patterns and flourishes along the body, lid, and base. The pitcher has a large, curved handle colored in cream with gold trim, as well as a pointed spout. On the central front area of the pitcher is an oval-shaped, framed painting showing two human figures near a tree, with one dressed in pink and seated while the other, dressed in light purple, stands holding a leafy branch toward the seated figure. The scene is surrounded by a white and gold border with intricate scrolling ornamentation. The lid of the pitcher is blue with gold detailing and is topped with a rounded, leaf-shaped finial also detailed in gold and cream. The background of the drawing is a plain, light-colored surface, and the pitcher is centrally placed within a squared outline on the page.
title: Chocolate Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
